shortDescription: AstraZeneca  LSE:AZN said on Tuesday its cancer drug Imfinzi combined with Amgen's NASDAQ:AMGN targeted immunotherapy Imdelltra significantly improved overall survival in first-line extensive-stage small cell lung cancer in a late-stage trial.
